definitions.explanation: The hand on the right side of the body.

examples.japanese: {右手|みぎて}で{箸|はし}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: To hold chopsticks with the right hand.

examples.japanese: {右手|みぎて}を{挙|あ}げてください。
{彼|かれ}は{右手|みぎて}に{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}って{歩|ある}いていた。
examples.english: He was walking with luggage in his right hand.

notes:
{右手|みぎて} combines {右|みぎ} (right) + {手|て} (hand). Can also mean "the right side" or "right-hand side" when giving directions.

READING NOTE:
Always read みぎて. The alternative reading うて is archaic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右手|みぎて}で{持|も}つ: to hold with the right hand
- {右手|みぎて}を{挙|あ}げる: to raise one's right hand
- {右手|みぎて}に{見|み}える: visible on the right side

DIRECTIONAL USE:
{右手|みぎて}に can mean "on your right" when giving directions: {右手|みぎて}に{公園|こうえん}が{見|み}えます (you'll see the park on your right).

RELATED WORDS:
- {左手|ひだりて}: left hand
- {両手|りょうて}: both hands
- {利|き}き{手|て}: dominant hand
- {右利|みぎき}き: right-handed
